title: Rapid Localization of Product Marketing Assets
business: Global e-commerce brands managing multi-region marketing campaigns.
problem: High operational costs and long turnaround times associated with manually re-editing video advertisements for different linguistic markets.
solution: Using the Runway ChatGPT plugin to automate the localization of existing video assets by generating localized spoken voiceovers and adjusting visual elements directly within the chat interface.
steps: Upload the original high-resolution product advertisement video to the Runway plugin interface.
Instruct the plugin to generate a localized spoken voiceover in the target language based on the provided script.
Utilize the plugin to perform targeted edits on existing footage to align visual text overlays with the new language.
Verify the output quality and export the localized video asset for immediate deployment to regional social media channels.
outcome: A streamlined workflow that reduces the time-to-market for localized video content while maintaining brand consistency across global regions.
limitation: The plugin may struggle with complex cultural nuances or idiomatic expressions in voiceover generation, requiring manual review of the generated audio to ensure tone and accuracy.
